name: Derby Hand Car Wash & Detailing
address: Gulfstream Park, 600 Silks Run unit 1275, Hallandale Beach, FL 33009, United States

reviewSamples.author: Zubayr Portillo
reviewSamples.text: Very impressed by the work they provided. I took my truck to this location because they specialized in pet hair removal and the result is perfect. Price is high, but worth every penny in my opinion. Highly Recommend, will return.

reviewSamples.author: Angie Villanueva
reviewSamples.text: Decent prices inside of the parking garage in Gulfstream plaza. I had the derby wash for an SUV for about thirty five dollars. It’s clean but could be perfected as there were a lot of surfaces that were left uncleaned. I don’t mind it because I just want my car to be clean and dust free but it would bother other people.

reviewSamples.author: Ilya Kovalov
reviewSamples.text: Great hand car wash! Fast, high-quality service at a very reasonable price. The car was washed thoroughly with great attention to detail. Everything was done professionally and efficiently. Definitely worth it - I’ll be coming back and highly recommend this place.
